tools.name: shipsgo_list_ocean_carriers
tools.description: List the ocean carriers ShipsGo supports, with their SCAC codes and status. Use the codes in ocean shipment tools. ShipsGo API: GET /v2/ocean/carriers.

tools.name: shipsgo_list_ocean_shipments
tools.description: List ocean container shipments on the account with status, carrier, route and dates. Filter by status, carrier, reference or container number. A sub-account with the Co-Worker role sees only its own shipments. ShipsGo API: GET /v2/ocean/shipments.

tools.name: shipsgo_get_ocean_shipment
tools.description: Get one ocean shipment with its status, containers, carrier and movement events. ShipsGo API: GET /v2/ocean/shipments/{shipment_id}.

tools.name: shipsgo_get_ocean_route
tools.description: Get the route of one ocean shipment as GeoJSON (ports and track points). ShipsGo API: GET /v2/ocean/shipments/{shipment_id}/geojson.

tools.name: shipsgo_create_ocean_shipment
tools.description: Start tracking an ocean shipment by booking number or container number. Creating a shipment uses account credits (HTTP 402 when none are left). A repeat with the same reference and booking number (or container number when no booking number is given) returns HTTP 409 with the existing shipment, at no

tools.name: shipsgo_update_ocean_shipment
tools.description: Change the reference of an ocean shipment. Only the reference can be changed here. ShipsGo API: PATCH /v2/ocean/shipments/{shipment_id}.

tools.name: shipsgo_delete_ocean_shipment
tools.description: Delete an ocean shipment from the account. Tracking stops and the shipment cannot be restored by this server. ShipsGo API: DELETE /v2/ocean/shipments/{shipment_id}.

tools.name: shipsgo_list_air_shipments
tools.description: List air cargo shipments on the account with status and dates. Filter by status, reference or AWB number. A sub-account with the Co-Worker role sees only its own shipments. ShipsGo API: GET /v2/air/shipments.

tools.name: shipsgo_get_air_shipment
tools.description: Get one air shipment with its status, movements and AWB details. ShipsGo API: GET /v2/air/shipments/{shipment_id}.

tools.name: shipsgo_get_air_route
tools.description: Get the route of one air shipment as GeoJSON (airports and track points). ShipsGo API: GET /v2/air/shipments/{shipment_id}/geojson.

tools.name: shipsgo_create_air_shipment
tools.description: Start tracking an air cargo shipment by AWB number. Creating a shipment uses account credits (HTTP 402 when none are left). A repeat with the same AWB number (and the same reference, when one is given) returns HTTP 409 with the existing shipment, at no cost. ShipsGo API: POST /v2/air/shipments.

tools.name: shipsgo_update_air_shipment
tools.description: Change the reference of an air shipment. Only the reference can be changed here. ShipsGo API: PATCH /v2/air/shipments/{shipment_id}.

tools.name: shipsgo_delete_air_shipment
tools.description: Delete an air shipment from the account. Tracking stops and the shipment cannot be restored by this server. ShipsGo API: DELETE /v2/air/shipments/{shipment_id}.
